newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BETIS COACH GIVEN FIRING ULTIMATUM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BETIS COACH GIVEN FIRING ULTIMATUM.

text.p: Real Betis coach Lorenzo Serra Ferrer will be fired at 1400 local time on Thursday unless he signs an agreement not to join Barcelona next season.
The unusual ultimatum, made by club owner Manuel Ruiz de Lopera, comes just nine days before Betis face Barcelona in the Spanish Cup final, the club's biggest game for 20 years.
Lopera announced the ultimatum in a radio programme in the early hours of Thursday.
Serra Ferrer is known to be tired of the pressures of running the Betis side, and is understood to be considering an offer to take over one of Barcelona's junior sides.
Valencia are also thought to have made him an offer.
